name: 9460-vlmdecode-qwen25vl3b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier
parallelism: tp1, pp1, dp1 -- ~6 GB of bf16 weights on an 80 GB card. Do not shard it and do not substitute a larger checkpoint.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 16 streams, 20% warmup, bounded at 400 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: Single-turn vision chat: one 768x768 JPEG plus a short instruction in, exactly 1024 tokens out. Prompt gaussian, mean 68, stdev 24, clipped to [16, 160]; output pinned with `ignore_eos`; one distinct image per request.
purpose: A photo question-answering assistant for sixteen concurrent users, writing 1024-token replies from a 3B vision model on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is DROPPED by the flat parser. host/port/
# served-model-name are not set here, and environment variables cannot live here.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
